contacts.name: Pieter Jansen
contacts.role: Partner account manager, Contoso Cloud Partners

intake.problem_statement: The data centre hosting contract for about 420 VMware servers ends in September 2027. The board needs an evidence-based view of the readiness, cost and licensing implications of moving to AWS before it decides to renew or migrate.
goals: Inventory and profile the estate from real utilisation data
Produce a rightsized AWS instance blueprint and cost scenarios (1-year, 3-year, 5-year)
Model BYOL versus License Included for Windows Server and SQL Server
Describe a high-level multi-AZ AWS target architecture and migration approach
Identify the AWS MAP funding Woodgrove could qualify for
intake.budget_range: EUR 38,000 one-time (funded in part by AWS)
constraints: Assessment only: no migration, remediation or build work
Banking data stays in the EU
The production target landing zone must span two Availability Zones
Read-only access to vCenter and a 21-day observation period have been agreed

findings: About 420 VMs across two data centres: roughly 300 Windows, 90 Linux, 30 SQL Server hosts
About 180 TB of allocated storage; actual utilisation is unknown
Microsoft Enterprise Agreement with SQL Server Enterprise and Software Assurance; no licence audit for three years
requirements: Rightsizing from observed CPU, memory, storage IOPS and network use
Region eu-west-1, with eu-central-1 as the alternative
discovery.notes: Kick-off workshop is planned for week 2.
